title: 39 Palmer Park, Rathfarnham, Dublin 16, D16AE29
description:
Highlights:

Extended 3 Bed, 2-Bath Family Home
Lovingly cared for and presented in excellent condition throughout
Superb west-facing private rear garden
Overlooking a large green area in a quiet residential cul de sac.
Ample off-street parking
Gas-fired central heating
Double-glazed windows throughout
Alarm system
Guest WC
Excellent transport links, including easy access to the M50
Close to  Marlay Park, St. Enda's Park and Rathfarnham Castle, Nutgrove Shopping Centre, Rathfarnham Shopping Centre and an excellent selection of schools and local amenities.

LWK Premium Collection are delighted to present 39 Palmer Park to the market.
This well-maintained and lovingly cared-for three-bedroom, two-bathroom family home is now presented in excellent condition throughout. The property offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation, a superb west-facing private rear garden and an enviable position overlooking a large green area.

The accommodation is both practical and well suited to modern family living. A welcoming entrance hall leads to the bright front reception room, currently used as a home office, making it an ideal space for those working from home.

There is excellent storage off the entrance hall, together with a convenient guest WC. This leads through to the extended kitchen and dining room, which is filled with natural light, is well equipped and benefits from direct access to the rear garden.

To the rear, the comfortable living room features an attractive fireplace and provides a warm and inviting space to relax. Overlooking the private rear garden, it also benefits from direct access through patio doors, creating a wonderful connection between the living accommodation and the garden.

Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms and a fully tiled family bathroom, completing the accommodation.

Outside, the west-facing rear garden is undoubtedly one of the property's standout features. Exceptionally private and not overlooked, it enjoys afternoon and evening sunshine and provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing. The garden is laid mainly in lawn, with mature planting, attractive hedging and a patio area. There is also the added benefit of a substantial block-built garden shed, providing excellent additional storage.

To the front, there is ample off-street parking, while the property's position overlooking a large green provides a wonderful sense of openness and is particularly appealing for families.

Location
Palmer Park is a mature and highly regarded residential development in the heart of Rathfarnham, offering a peaceful, family-friendly setting with an excellent range of amenities close by. The property is within easy reach of Rathfarnham Village, Nutgrove Shopping Centre and Dundrum Town Centre, with an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants and local amenities nearby.

The area is particularly well served by a selection of highly regarded primary and secondary schools, while Marlay Park, St. Enda's Park and Rathfarnham Castle provide superb recreational facilities for all ages. Excellent public transport links and close proximity to the M50 ensure convenient access to Dublin City Centre, Sandyford and Dublin Airport.

39 Palmer Park represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a much-loved family home in a highly sought-after Dublin 16 location. Lovingly maintained and thoughtfully extended, with a superb private west-facing garden and a wonderful outlook over the green, on a quiet cul de sac. This is a home that offers space, comfort and an excellent quality of life in a mature and well-established setting.
